via-the-astral-contact-spell.text: Conversations will be cycled through in the following order:

steps.player: Hello mate. What are you up to now?

steps.npc: Erm, I'm a bit busy at the moment.

steps.player: Ooooh, I bet you're travelling across the seas. Or maybe you're visiting the world leaders?

steps.npc: Well, I'm trying to fight TzTok-Jad at the moment.
Yes, he's level 702 in Combat.
Thanks. Arghhhh, death to you foul beast!
Oh, hi.

steps.player: What adventure are you now on?

steps.npc: Well, I just dispatched TzTok-Jad. Pretty tough! I'm now on my way to the desert. I'm going to see if I can hunt down this Kalphite Queen everyone's been telling me about.

steps.player: I should warn you, you'll need a team to take that beast on.

steps.npc: I've already thought of that. I've arranged for a couple of the Slayer masters to join me.

steps.player: Wow! I wish I could witness that!

steps.npc: That's funny, I was just talking about you.
Yes, I've been arranging a meeting between various leaders of Gielinor to discuss some political issues. It seems you have certainly been around a bit!

steps.player: I suppose I have. What issues are you going to be discussing in this meeting? Who will be there?

steps.npc: Sorry, that's top secret information.

steps.player: Hey there, where are you now?

steps.npc: Well, I thought I'd try out this place called the Wilderness.
Quite a gloomy place.
Oh! I can see someone.
He seems to be coming this way.
Yes, he's definitely looking at me.
He's wearing some impressive armour.

steps.player: Watch out! He's going to attack you!

steps.npc: Surely not. Oh, look, there's another two of them coming to meet me.

steps.player: They're in a clan, they're going to fight you!

steps.npc: I don't think so.
Hi there gentlemen! Nice day...
Woah, take it easy! Hey, stop that!
I'll teach you to hit me! Have this!
That'll teach them.
Of course. Easy.
